paper_title: Whole genome sequencing revealed microbiome in lung adenocarcinomas presented as ground-glass nodules

validation_flags: No individual abundance comparison between tumor and normal tissue reported at phylum level
criticism_flags: 3B: paper characterizes 'core microbiota' present in 100% of all 15 samples including normal controls — not a directional disease finding
_annotation_metadata.review_notes: Paper defines core microbiota as taxa present in all 15 samples (both GGN tumor and adjacent normal). Community-level Jaccard distance difference (P=0.047) is the only disease-relevant finding; per-taxon directional comparisons are not provided. Direction unclear. Sufficiency_fail=true.
